text:
ci-bot: Merge 87a2e3 into main by @sam triggered pipeline https://ci.redwood.example/ci/12345 — 3 failing jobs (unit-tests-3, integration-5, lint-2)

sam: saw it come in, looks like my batching tweak from PR #987 landed. opening this thread to triage — who owns the failing jobs? :eyes:

leah: pinging oncall and eng-infra. I can try a quick rerun on the flaky job.

mike: starting with rerun for unit-tests-3: `/ci rerun job=unit-tests-3 build=12345`

ci-bot: Rerun queued: unit-tests-3 (requeue id 54321).

mike: rerun finished — unit-tests-3 ✅ passed. integration-5 still failing.

ada: quick glance at integration-5 logs, failure looks like TestKVCacheEviction timed out / OOM in gpu-runner. snippet:```
E TestKVCacheEviction: expected eviction happened within 10s, got timeout
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "/workspace/tests/test_kv_cache.py", line 78, in test_eviction
    assert cache.size() <= MAX_SIZE
AssertionError
```

leah: that test has been flaky historically when GPU memory is saturated. could be a noisy runner or a real regression from the batching change.

sam: my change reduced max-batch-size heuristics for dynamic batching, might affect memory patterns. i'll start a quick bisect locally to see if PR 987 is the culprit.

oncall: creating a temporary annotation on the pipeline and increasing job concurrency limits for integration-5 to rule out contention: `/ci update job=integration-5 concurrency=2`

mike: good call. I kicked another run with the new concurrency.

ci-bot: New run queued for build 12346 (integration-5).

mike: run failed again, same test, same stack. marking it as likely regression.

leah: can you reproduce locally, @sam? if yes, we should either revert PR 987 or ship a quick patch to reduce memory use.

sam: reproducing now — local e2e with the changed batching reproduces eviction failure 3/3 runs. git bisect pointing to the batching heuristic commit in PR 987.

sam: putting up an emergency revert PR to unblock main: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/compare/revert-987 — will request immediate review.

ada: :thumbsup: If revert is approved, we can fast-track it and re-run the full pipeline.

mike: I'll monitor the re-run and follow up with a postmortem note in #postmortems if we confirm regression.

leah: thanks everyone. action items: sam open revert (in flight), mike watch reruns, ada collect flaky history for TestKVCacheEviction, leah to add regression note on the PR.

sam: reverting now. will update thread when the revert is merged and pipeline status clears. :rocket:
